Tucked away in a secluded valley surrounded by ancient trees, this yurt features a large 5-foot skylight, perfect for stargazing. services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: Our RV sites offer the perfect blend of nature and comfort. Our sites come equipped with a fire pit, picnic table, city water, sewer, 30 amp power, and are pet friendly to make your stay both enjoyable and convenient. Back RV Park (Sites 19 - 36): For a camping experience closer to nature (sites 19 - 27 are pull-through sites). A $2.00 daily power surcharge is applied to long term bookings prior to May 1 and after Sept. 30 Pets are welcome on a leash in RV site area only. Pet must be no more then 50 lbs and must be picked up

services.name: REN Massage & Wellness at EIR
services.desc: We’re thrilled to welcome Ren Massage & Wellness to EIR this season! A massage in the forest is exactly what your body and soul need, whether you’re soaking in nature or need to recharge. Ren’s professional team offers a range of wellness services, from gentle relaxation to deep tissue work - facilitating your ability to unwind during your stay. ✨ Imagine listening to birdsong while your stress fades. That’s the magic of massage in the woods. No need to fret! We've got you covered. Simply fill out this short form below to join our waitlist. If any additional massage sessions open up, you'll be the first to know. That way, you can secure your spot to enjoy a blissful forest

services.name: Yoga with Kyla
services.desc: We’re so excited to invite you to Kyla’s first yoga retreat!Escape the city for a soul-nourishing Sunday just 45 minutes from Edmonton-and be home in time for dinner. If you register in the first week, you’ll also receive 10% off your ticket with code EARLYBIRD! What’s in store?We’ll start the day with coffee and light bites, followed by a grounding one-hour yoga session. Afterward, enjoy a nourishing lunch and a glass of wine, then spend the afternoon however you like-relaxing in the immersive glass sauna, lounging by the fire, exploring forest trails, or journaling with gentle guidance. You’re also welcome to stop into Elk Island National Park to see the bisonbefore heading home

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Bison Backstage is the exclusive, behind the scenes look at bison conservation at Elk Island. Visitors will be led through the Plains Bison Handling Facility and along the way will learn about the history of bison, how they affect the prairie landscape around them, and how parks staff herd these magnificent wild animals through the world-class plains bison handling facility as a tool to connect visitors to Canada’s bison story and Parks Canada’s ongoing role in bison conservation efforts.Organizer information Fees: View cost on fee page; teachers and chaperones are complimentary when visiting for a school program Audience: This program is suitable for school, tour, and private groups.

services.name: ÖÖD Sauna
services.desc: We are proud to present an immersive Nordic sauna experience, straight from Estonia, brought to you by ÖÖD. Step into Canada’s first Mirrored Sauna by ÖÖD House, a peaceful haven where rustic charm meets modern relaxation. Surrounded by the serene natural beauty of our retreat, this dry sauna experience is designed to provide warmth, tranquility, and a deep connection with nature. Whether you’re here for a solo retreat or a shared experience, our sauna offers the perfect escape. To immerse yourself in our Nordic Sauna, simply add the sauna as a package during check-out with an accommodation reservation, or book a standalone session using the "Book Now" button.
